name: pcm
description: Personal Crypto Messenger - E2E encrypted desktop messenger

scripts.dev:alice: npx cross-env PCM_PROFILE=alice npm run dev:client
scripts.dev:bob: npx cross-env PCM_PROFILE=bob npm run dev:client
scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n "server,alice" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:alice"
scripts.dev:3: npx concurrently -n "server,alice,bob" -c "magenta,cyan,yellow" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:alice" "npm run dev:bob"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:shared && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
